paragraphs: Our business and operations, and our industry in general, are subject to a variety of risks. If any event arising from the risk factors set forth below occurs, our business, financial condition, results of operations, liquidity, the trading prices of our securities and in some cases our reputation could be materially and adversely affected. When assessing the materiality of the foregoing risk factors, we consider several qualitative and quantitative factors, including, but not limited to, financial, operational, environmental, regulatory, reputational and safety aspects of the identified risk factor. The risks described below may not be the only risks we face, as our business, operations and industry may also be subject to risks that we do not yet know of, or that we currently believe are immaterial. The disclosures in this section reflect our beliefs and opinions as to factors that could materially and adversely affect us in the future. References to past events are provided by way of example only and are not intended to be a complete listing or a representation as to whether or not such factors have occurred in the past.
The Company's risk factors are summarized as market; operational; environmental; financial; regulatory; tax and general risks associated with business and industry.

• A substantial or extended decline in oil, NGLs or natural gas prices, or a substantial increase in oil, NGLs and natural gas price differentials, could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations, and the trading prices of our securities.
• The trading price of our securities, including our common stock, is subject to volatility.
• Fluctuations in exchange rates could affect expenses or result in realized and unrealized losses.
• Our ability to operate and complete projects is dependent on numerous factors outside of our control.

headings: Upstream Product Revenues, Excluding Realized Gains (Losses) on Risk Management
paragraphs: Ovintiv aims to be a leading North American energy producer and is focused on developing its high-quality multi-basin portfolio of oil and natural gas producing plays as part of its strategy outlined in Items 1 and 2 of this Annual Report on Form 10-K.

Ovintiv is committed to delivering quality returns from its capital investment, generating significant cash flows and providing durable cash returns to its shareholders through the commodity price cycle. The Company aims to achieve its strategic priorities through execution excellence, disciplined capital allocation, and commercial acumen and risk management. In addition, the Company is dedicated to driving progress in the area of sustainability, aligning with its commitment to corporate responsibility.

In support of the Company's commitment to enhancing shareholder value, Ovintiv utilizes its shareholder return framework to provide competitive returns to shareholders while strengthening its balance sheet.

Ovintiv continually monitors and evaluates changing market conditions to maximize cash flows, mitigate risks and renew its premium well inventory. The Company's high-quality assets, located in the United States and Canada, form a multi-basin, multi-product portfolio which enables flexible and efficient investment of capital that supports the Company's strategy.

Ovintiv seeks to deliver results in a socially and environmentally responsible manner. Best practices are deployed across its assets, allowing the Company to capitalize on operational efficiencies and decrease emissions intensity. The Company's sustainability reporting, which outlines its key metrics, targets and relative progress achieved, can be found in the Company Outlook section of this MD&A and on the Company's sustainability website.

Underpinning Ovintiv's strategy are core values of one, agile, innovative and driven, which guide the organization to be collaborative, responsive, flexible and determined. The Company is committed to excellence with a passion to drive corporate financial performance and shareholder value.

For additional information on Ovintiv's strategy, its reporting segments and the plays in which the Company operates, refer to Items 1 and 2 of this Annual Report on Form 10-K. For additional information on the segmented results, refer to Note 2 to the Consolidated Financial Statements included in Item 8 of this Annual Report on Form 10‑K.

In evaluating its operations and assessing its leverage, Ovintiv reviews performance-based measures such as Non‑GAAP Cash Flow and debt-based metrics such as Debt to Adjusted Capitalization, Debt to EBITDA and Debt

to Adjusted EBITDA, which are non-GAAP measures and do not have any standardized meaning under U.S. GAAP. These measures may not be similar to measures presented by other issuers and should not be viewed as a substitute for measures reported under U.S. GAAP. Additional information regarding these measures, including reconciliations to the closest GAAP measure, can be found in the Non-GAAP Measures section of this MD&A.

During 2025, the Company focused on executing its capital investment plan aimed at maximizing profitability through operational and capital efficiencies, and delivering cash from operating activities. In conjunction with the Montney Acquisition, as discussed below, the Company has fully integrated the new assets into its existing operations.

The Company had lower upstream product revenues in 2025 compared to 2024, which primarily resulted from lower oil production volumes and lower average realized liquids prices, excluding the impact of risk management activities, partially offset by higher plant condensate production volumes and higher average realized natural gas prices, excluding the impact of risk management activities. Oil production volumes decreased primarily as a result of the sale of the Company's Uinta assets in the first quarter of 2025. Average realized oil and plant condensate prices decreased 11 percent and 12 percent, respectively, primarily due to lower benchmark prices. Plant condensate production volumes increased due to the Montney Acquisition in the first quarter of 2025. Higher average realized natural gas prices of 39 percent were primarily due to higher benchmark prices and exposure to other downstream benchmark prices. Ovintiv continues to focus on optimizing realized prices from the diversification of the Company's downstream markets.

paragraphs: Ovintiv 旨在成為北美地區的領先能源生產者，並專注於發展其高品質的多盆地油氣生產資產組合，作為其在本年度報告表 10-K 第 1 與第 2 項所列策略的一部分。
Ovintiv 承諾透過其資本投資，提供優質回報，產生顯著現金流，並在能源價格週期中為股東提供可持續的現金回報。本公司旨在透過執行卓越、謹慎的資本配置及商業判斷與風險管理，實現其戰略優先事項。此外，本公司致力於推動永續發展領域的進步，並與其對企業責任的承諾一致。
為支持本公司提升股東價值的承諾，Ovintiv 透過其股東回報架構，為股東提供具競爭力的回報，同時強化其資產負債表。
Ovintiv 持續監測與評估變動的市場條件，以最大化現金流、降低風險並更新其高價值油井存貨。本公司位於美國與加拿大的高品質資產，形成多盆地、多產品的資產組合，使資本投資更具彈性與效率，支持本公司戰略。
Ovintiv 希望以社會與環境責任的方式提供成果。最佳實踐方式已應用於其資產，使本公司能利用運營效率並降低排放強度。本公司永續發展報告，說明其關鍵指標、目標與相對進展，可於本年度報告表 MD&A 的公司展望部分及本公司永續發展網站找到。
支撐 Ovintiv 策略的基礎價值觀為一體、靈活、創新與努力，引導組織成為協作、靈活、具彈性與決心的團隊。本公司致力於卓越，並以熱情推動企業財務表現與股東價值。
如需更多關於 Ovintiv 策略、其報告分部及本公司運營的資產，請參閱本年度報告表 10-K 第 1 與第 2 項。如需更多關於分部結果的資訊，請參閱本年度報告表 10-K 第 8 項所包含的合併財務陳述書附註 2。
在評估其運營及評估其槓桿時，Ovintiv 會審視基於表現的指標，如非 GAAP 現金流，以及基於負債的指標，如負債對調整後資本化、負債對 EBITDA 及負債
調整後之 EBITDA，為非 GAAP 財務指標，且在美國 GAAP 下並無標準化定義。這些指標可能與其他發行人的財務指標不同，不應視為美國 GAAP 財務指標之替代。有關這些指標之額外資訊，包括與最近之 GAAP 財務指標之對應關係，可於本 MD&A 之非 GAAP 財務指標部分找到。
2025 年，本公司專注於執行其資本投資計畫，旨在透過營運與資本效率來最大化獲利，並從營運活動中產生現金。配合如下方所述之 Montney 收購，本公司已將新資產完全整合至現有營運中。

2025 年本公司之上游產品營收較 2024 年為低，主要係因原油產量減少，且扣除風險管理活動影響後之平均實現液體價格較低，部分抵銷因素為植物凝結物產量增加，以及扣除風險管理活動影響後之平均實現天然氣價格較高。原油產量減少主要係因本公司於 2025 年第一季出售 Uinta 資產所致。扣除風險管理活動影響後之平均實現原油與植物凝結物價格分別下降 11% 與 12%，主要係因基準價格較低。植物凝結物產量因 2025 年第一季之 Montney 收購而增加。扣除風險管理活動影響後之平均實現天然氣價格提高 39%，主要係因基準價格提高，以及對其他下游基準價格之敞口增加。Ovintiv 繼續專注於透過本公司下游市場多元化來優化實現價格。

headings: 環境風險及與氣候變遷相關的風險
本公司證券，包括普通股，其交易價格可能出現波動。
匯率波動可能影響費用或導致實現及未實現損失。
本公司營運及完成專案的能力取決於許多無法控制的因素。
本公司營運涉及許多風險，其中一些可能導致未預見的中斷，並使本公司面臨重大損失與責任，而本公司之保險可能無法完全保障本公司。
油氣探勘、開發及生產活動涉及重大成本與風險，且可能無法取得具商業價值之儲備。
若本公司未能尋找、開發或取得額外之油氣及天然氣儲備，本公司之儲備與產量將大幅下降。
水平多井平台鑽井涉及某些風險，可能導致本公司營運結果之波動。
本公司受取得公司之風險與責任所影響，且預期或期望之取得公司之好處可能無法實現。
本公司依賴合作夥伴為某些透過合資公司及合作關係進行之專案提供資金。
本公司並未營運所有之資產，且在該等情況下，本公司可能對該等資產之營運與發展有有限之影響力。
本公司客戶、交易對手及貸款人可能無法履行其契約或法律義務。
本公司保留與2009年11月公司重組相關之某些賠償義務。
本公司可能無法處分某些資產，並可能需保留某些事項之負債。
本公司營運可能受原住民條約、土地所有權及其他權利之影響。
本公司面臨各營運所在地所實施之環境法規持續演進所帶來之風險與不確定性。
paragraphs: 本公司之業務與營運，以及整體產業，均面臨多種風險。若來自下列風險因素之任何事件發生，將可能對本公司之業務、財務狀況、營運結果、流動性、證券交易價格，以及在某些情況下本公司之聲譽，造成重大且不利之影響。評估前述風險因素之重大性時，本公司考量多種質性與量化因素，包括但不限於已識別風險因素之財務、營運、環境、法規、聲譽與安全等層面。下列所描述之風險可能並非本公司所面臨之唯一風險，因本公司之業務、營運與產業亦可能面臨本公司尚未知悉，或目前認為不重要之風險。本節之揭露反映本公司對未來可能對本公司造成重大且不利影響之因素之看法與意見。對過去事件之提及僅為說明之用，並非完整列出或表示過去是否曾發生過這些因素。
本公司之風險因素可歸納為市場；營運；環境；財務；法規；稅務及一般與業務與產業相關之風險。
• 油價、NGLs 或天然氣價格出現顯著或持續下跌，或油價、NGLs 與天然氣價格差異出現顯著增加，可能對本公司之業務、財務狀況、營運結果，以及本公司證券之交易價格造成重大且不利之影響。
• 本公司證券之交易價格，包括本公司普通股，可能受到波動影響。
• 貨幣兌換率之波動可能影響費用，或導致實現與未實現之損失。
• 本公司執行營運與完成專案之能力，取決於許多本公司無法控制之因素。
